# Vacuum

Show vacuum status, supported cleaning actions and an optional map preview inside the tile.

## Required Home Assistant integration

The tile needs a **[vacuum](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/vacuum/)** entity from the integration of your robot, for example Roborock or Matter. An optional map needs an `image.*` entity and the cleaning mode a `select.*` entity of the same integration.

## Configure in the editor

1. Open a page in the [web editor](../editor.md#layout-workspace) and add **Vacuum**.
2. Use **Search** beside the entity field to choose an entity by name. Configure its options below.
3. Resize the widget for its content, then **Save** the layout. Try its controls on the panel.

Select the vacuum first. Optionally choose an image entity for an inline map and a select entity for cleaning mode. The action buttons follow the vacuum's capabilities; a suction-level picker appears when it reports fan-speed choices. Cleaning mode remains a separate optional select entity. The picture has no room-selection popup. An optional battery sensor (for example a separate `sensor.*` with the charge in %) replaces the entity's own battery value; the chip is hidden while no value is known. With **History on tap (Lock, Vacuum: long press)** a long press on the card opens the last 24 hours of the vacuum's activity (cleaning, returning, docked) from Home Assistant Recorder. The legacy roborock_tile layout name uses this same widget.

## Entities and interaction

**Supported primary entities:** `vacuum.*`

| Setting / behaviour | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Options | start/pause, stop, dock, suction level and cleaning mode pickers; optional inline map image; optional battery sensor (battery_entity_id, the only source of the charge since Home Assistant 2026.9; the editor suggests it for a new card) |
| Interaction | action buttons tap directly; the suction and mode chips open their pickers; the picture is read-only; with history popup a long press on the card opens the last 24 hours of activity |

## Recent activity popup

Enable **History on tap (Lock, Vacuum: long press)** in the inspector, save, then long-press the card (not a button). The popup shows the last 24 hours of the vacuum's state from Home Assistant Recorder as a timeline and a list of changes (cleaning, returning, docked); it is read-only.

<a href="../img/gallery/gallery_vacuum_history_glow.png"><img src="../img/gallery/gallery_vacuum_history_glow.png" alt="Vacuum activity, glow" loading="lazy" width="720" height="720" style="width: 576px"></a>

The popup is a simulator example (Glow style) with synthetic data.

## Layout limits

- Minimum: **240 × 220 px**.
- Maximum: **dashboard width × dashboard height**, capped by the selected display device's dashboard area.
- Leave space for the value, title and touch controls; the minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size.

The [display device overview](../choose-display.md) lists usable dashboard geometry. [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains title/content spacing and touch targets.
